fonts.display: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Instrument Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, all borders, logo forms, icon strokes — the structural near-black that defines every contour across the system

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background — warm off-white that gives the entire system its gallery-wall warmth rather than clinical white

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Card surfaces, article blocks, elevated panels — pure white sits on top of Canvas to create subtle layering without shadows

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Hairline borders, divider lines, subtle structural rules — the thinnest visible grid

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Secondary borders, muted fills, icon strokes at lower emphasis

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Muted surface for category tags, soft chips, low-emphasis backgrounds — warm-tinted neutral that steps between Paper and Canvas

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Muted body text, secondary copy — warm dark gray for hierarchy below Ink

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Tertiary text, timestamps, metadata — the lightest readable gray

palette.name: Bronze
palette.role: Sparingly used warm accent — appears as small punctuation dots or category indicators, never as fills; adds a whisper of warmth to the achromatic system

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary accent — cool counterpoint to Bronze, used in equally restrained dot/tag contexts to create subtle color rhythm
